entry.name: gen_dsp_triangle
entry.description: A triangle/ramp wavetable with input to change phase offset of the peak value. The phase ranges from 0 to 1 (and wraps outside these values). With a duty cycle of 0, it produces a descending sawtooth; with a duty cycle of 1 it produces ascending sawtooth; with a duty cycle of 0.5 it produces a triangle waveform. Output values always bounded in 0 to 1.
